name: Panzer Hearts
source:
Panzer Hearts is a story-driven game filled with romance and adventure. The setting is an alternate history WW2 where the warmongering “Empire” is terrorizing its friendly neighbors. The young men and women brainwashed by the Empire see the war of aggression as justified.

In Panzer Hearts you take the role of a young, naive soldier, Bastian. Wounded in the battle you get a second chance to serve the Empire in a factory building tanks to the front. Some of the people in the factory are linked to Bastian's past and some to his future. Bastian also gets to date beautiful girls.

They say love is blind, but in this case love and where it leads our young protagonist can completely change his future and the course of the war. A chain of events and a cry from his past make Bastian question his loyalty and his side in the war.

Build the tanks, date the girls, choose your side.
translation:
《装甲之心》是一款充满恋爱与冒险、以剧情为核心的游戏。舞台是一个架空历史中的第二次世界大战，好战的“帝国”正在恐吓友邻。被帝国洗脑的年轻男女认为侵略战争是正当的。

在《装甲之心》中，你将扮演天真年轻的士兵巴斯蒂安。你在战斗中受伤后得到第二次机会，在工厂中为帝国制造前线坦克。工厂里有些人和巴斯蒂安的过去有关，有些人则会成为他的未来。巴斯蒂安还可以和美丽女孩约会。

有人说爱情是盲目的，但在这里，爱情以及它把主人公带向的方向，完全能够改变他的未来和战争进程。一连串事件与来自过去的呼喊，让巴斯蒂安开始质疑自己的忠诚与立场。

制造坦克、和女孩约会，选择你的阵营。
